notes: Four co-transmitters meet in one level: «قال يحيى بن يحيى أخبرنا وقال الآخرون، حدثنا» changes only the verb, not the names
Gloss «- يعنون ابن جعفر -» left out; «أنه سمع ابن عمر، يقول» makes Ibn Umar the last link, the Companion reporting the Prophet's words
Usama appears in the story only and is not a link
